रेचक, i. e. रिच् + अक,
 I. adj. Purgative, aperient.
 II. m.
 1. A purgative.
 2. A proper name,

(but cf. Wilson, Spec. of the Theatre of the Hind. i. 2. ed. p. 260, n.).
 III. n. A purge.
 IV. m. or n. Exhalation, Bhāg.
; a method of suppressing the breath, Vedāntas. in

रेचन, i. e. रिच् + अन, n., and f. ना,
 1. Purging, looseness.
 2. Evacuating, Bhāṣāp. 6.
